source_note: 证明函数项级数几乎处处绝对收敛
english_source_note: Almost Everywhere Absolute Convergence of Function Series
callout_id: 证明函数项级数几乎处处绝对收敛#1
statement_en: Let $a_n,r_n$ be two real sequences satisfying $\sum_{n\geq 1}|a_n|<\infty$. Prove that the series $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{a_n}{\sqrt{|x-r_n|}}$$ is absolutely convergent for almost every $x\in \mathbb{R}$.
callout_body: 考虑两个实数列$a_n,r_n$满足$\sum_{n\geq 1}|a_n|<\infty$，证明级数$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{a_n}{\sqrt{|x-r_n|}}$$对$x\in \mathbb{R}$是几乎处处绝对收敛的。
